propositions: The mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out patchset tree, which occurs when a change is based on a commit older than the commit that introduced the script.
The gate incorrectly reports Verified -1 without analyzing change quality when the script file is missing, rather than skipping with an explanatory message like sibling gates do.

Other gates in the same workflow (env-var registry gate, check_comment_hygiene.py) already guard against this scenario by detecting the missing script and exiting cleanly with an informational message instead of failing.

The mutation gate must skip cleanly with exit 0 and an explanatory message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, while still executing the gate for changes based at or after the script's introduction commit.
